problem_observed: The existing code editor surface used Monaco but still felt like a generic web editor.
The user needs code copy/editing that supports platform work rather than another UI candidate.
The previous product-layout work fixed width and performance but did not make the editor workflow platform-specific.
accepted_decisions: Keep Monaco as the code editing engine because it is already installed and officially exposes editor options and theme APIs.
Customize the editor around the platform's repeated artifacts: requirements, specs, validation, Tauri commands, agent configs, and decision records.
Add patch-context copy so the source editor can hand off a structured draft to agent work.
rejected_options: Clone or install a full open-source editor application for this bounded slice.
Leave the Monaco panel as a generic editor with only copy/save controls.
Add pure-browser write capability outside the Tauri scoped backup gate.
validation_gate: Check/build/perf/test/browser smoke must pass before commit.
